Natural Earth 1:110m countries via world-atlas 2.0.2.
Source: https://unpkg.com/world-atlas@2.0.2/countries-110m.json
Natural Earth data: public domain, https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/
TopoJSON converted to GeoJSON without changing coordinates.

China regional road and province-boundary layers:
https://naciscdn.org/naturalearth/10m/cultural/ne_10m_roads.zip
https://naciscdn.org/naturalearth/10m/cultural/ne_10m_admin_1_states_provinces_lines.zip
Source documentation:
https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/10m-cultural-vectors/roads/
https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/10m-cultural-vectors/10m-admin-1-states-provinces/
Clipped to longitude 73–136, latitude 17–54, rounded to 5 decimals, simplified
for the national overview and closer views. No labels or source attributes included.
Rebuild with tools/build-photography-map.py using local source archives.
